ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent TV accessory purchases do not suggest I need a streaming device right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in practical camera and device accessories than adding voice control.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recorded TV is 720p, so the 4K features offer little immediate value.
ItemID: 4; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already bought a Fire 7 and its accessories, so another older tablet feels redundant.
ItemID: 5; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Earbuds could be useful, but nothing in my recent purchases points to an immediate audio need.
ItemID: 6; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I repeatedly buy memory cards and recently bought a card reader; I would choose this for compatible devices.
ItemID: 7; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: HD suits my TV, but I have no current reason to add streaming hardware.
ItemID: 8; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Connection accessories fit my interests, but I would check my ports and required cable length before choosing it.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart display does not address the camera, storage, or connection needs reflected in my purchases.
ItemID: 10; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX2700 - Coverage Up to 800 Sq Ft and 10 devices with N300 Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 300Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would only consider this for a known Wi-Fi coverage problem, which my history does not establish.
